name: smwsprites-3-up-moon-sprite-v2
title: 3-UP Moon Sprite V2.0
description:
3-UP Moon Sprite V2.0:

Description: A sprite that tries to mimic the 3-UP Moon Object tile from SMW, but in sprite form! It's a bit different from the existing one, it acts with new behaviours! obviously, this will works like the Object tile, but you can add/modify stuff!

Features:
PIXI Support/Compatibility.
SA-1 Support/Compatibility.
JSON Support.
A documentation (Readme) file.
Allow customize the sprite easily with an Extra Byte.

More details are on the documentation (Readme) file!

Requested by NopeContest
